_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fiber_reinforced#0. An HGO material with <mat_axis> DELETED produces logged data BIT-IDENTICAL to the same material with a = (1,0,0), d = (0,1,0) written out, while a frame aligned with the load gives measurably different stresses. All three runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning, which is why the omission survives a smoke test. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
